signing_profile: Each cohort uses its named algorithm for client and server signing. Record every actual peer/key algorithm; do not infer one from a TLS certificate.

network_scope.local: Owned clients/server on the named native OS using loopback and configured trust.
network_scope.remote-profile-fixture: Isolated Remote-profile boundaries. Mac server/Linux guest and Ubuntu systemd server/separate network-namespace client are existing bounded fixture precedents, not named WAN hosts. Record the actual topology/addresses/kernel/emulation per cell; a precedent is not a current cell pass.
network_scope.named_remote: Concrete external-host execution belongs to the separately authorized G6-093/G6-095 lane. No such execution is authorized or implied by this manifest.

qualification_rules: All 32 cells require their own exact source, platform, runtime, topology and result evidence.
A native peer, independent Rust HTTP3 peer or Node WebSocket SDK control result cannot qualify a Chrome, Firefox or decoded-media cell.
The media profile, frozen browser versions and all behavior requirements remain binding while G6-054 is deferred.
Uninstalled browser/remote environments and unexecuted cell producers remain not-run.
Capture files, synthetic state, credentials and raw logs stay private; only bounded redacted results and hashes are published.
